system.description:
Traveler

Most people in the shinobi world live and die within a few miles of where they were born. You are not one of them. You come from a distant place, so remote that few people know it exists, and those who have heard of your homeland know little beyond its name. You have arrived at one of the Great Shinobi Villages for reasons you may or may not choose to share, carrying a perspective that is both foreign to those around you and full of wonders you have never seen before..

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Perception

Tool Proficiencies: Poison Kit

Equipment: One set of traveler's clothes, any one gaming set from your homeland, a poorly written map from your homeland that depict where you are in the world, a small piece of jewelry worth 10 Ryo in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship.

Equipment Pack: Traveler’s or Explorer’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: The Exotic Individual

Your accent, mannerisms, and appearance mark you as an outsider wherever you go. This draws curious glances and can occasionally be a nuisance, but it also earns you the genuine interest of scholars, nobles, and everyday folk alike, all eager to hear about distant lands. You can use this attention to gain access to people and places that would otherwise be out of reach, for yourself and your companions.

Experienced

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Wisdom based Skill Feat)
